title: After Change Customer and Reverse, invoicing again bills the new customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer D, the new customer, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced (no payment, deposit or credit applied), that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Change Customer (the two arrows at the top right of the Customer card).
  3. Pick customer D.
  4. Confirm the change.
  5. Open the Finance tab.
  6. Reverse the invoice.
  7. Click Create Invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The customer picker opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer D is picked.

Step 4:

  • The work order's customer is customer D.

Step 5:

  • The existing invoice's Bill To block still names customer A: the invoice keeps its Bill To.

Step 6:

  • The invoice is removed and work order 1 goes back to Complete.

Step 7:

  • The new invoice's Bill To block names customer D: invoicing again bills the new customer, as today.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12308 (Story 6, Change Customer with a Bill To)

  • S6-N1: “On an Invoiced document, the invoice keeps its Bill To. A self-billed document stays self-billed, so invoicing again after Reverse bills the new customer, as today.”
  • Key Decisions: “Change Customer never makes a self-billed document bill the old customer. On an invoiced document the invoice keeps its Bill To; after Reverse, invoicing again bills the new customer, as today.”
  • Feature Overview, State by action (Action | Open | Invoiced | Internal or No Charge): “Change Customer | Allowed. A default Bill To follows, a picked one stays. Deposits block only if the Bill To would change. | As today; the invoice keeps its Bill To. A self-billed document stays self-billed. | As the Internal Work Orders PRD”
